subject: english
title: Unit 4 Opener
subtitle: Get Well Soon! — a girl with a colorful cast: analyze the photo, make inferences, illness or injury, and start Leo’s Health Notebook.

content: Analyze the opener photo (SB pp. 60–61) for information.
Make inferences: how does the girl feel, and what clue shows it? (key: a broken arm · It hurts, but she feels fine.)
Preview the nine stops of Unit 4.
language: Tell an illness from an injury.
Use cast, plaster and thumbs up.
Say “Get well soon” and answer “When were you last sick?”

notes: SB p. 60 questions are verbatim from the Student Book; the key is from the SB answer key. Be the Expert facts from LP p. 135.
